scope: mobile detail classification, deterministic parent return, native history preservation, and viewport-stable URLs

routingEvidence.nativeHistory: Home to channel and Members to human profile incremented history, used data-back-mode=history, returned with history -1, and remained available to browser forward
routingEvidence.replaceParent: channel chatTab changes retain their history index; return uses data-back-mode=replace-parent so it cannot jump over the channel
routingEvidence.deepLinkParent: hard-loaded channel, Account, and machine-detail URLs had no trusted previous parent and used data-back-mode=parent
routingEvidence.queryHash: channel Tasks preserved ui=baseline, msg=m1, and #latest while removing only chatTab on return
routingEvidence.viewportChange: resizing /s/open-tag from 390px to 768px swapped Home for desktop Chat and back without changing the URL

journeyEvidence.homeChannelHome: Home scrollTop 190 survived channel navigation and native return; channel detail hid primary navigation
journeyEvidence.nativeForward: forward returned from Home to the same channel detail URL
journeyEvidence.membersProfileMembers: Members to /human/:id used native history and returned with Members selected
journeyEvidence.settingsAccountSettings: hard-loaded /settings/account returned deterministically to /settings with Settings selected
journeyEvidence.machineDetailComputers: the isolated workspace had no real machines; /computer/missing-fixture still classified as computer-detail and returned to /computer without horizontal overflow
journeyEvidence.keyboard: the 44px Back control accepted Enter and returned Account to Settings
journeyEvidence.hiddenLegacyDrawer: the old off-canvas sidebar is display:none in Baseline mobile, so it casts no shadow and contributes no hidden focus targets

detailHeaderCriticalRegion.method: luma SSIM on the unmasked 2px header divider and straight 2px visible Back-control border segments

fullPage.reason: message/thread/composer content belongs to ticket #309 and Account/Settings content belongs to #313; #308 does not mask those still-unaligned module regions

intentionalDifferences: OpenTag keeps its licensed Lucide ArrowLeft glyph; the visible control border and geometry, not the private reference glyph pixels, are compared.
The Back control exposes a 44px touch target around the reference-matched 28px visible box.
No machine was created merely for screenshot parity; the missing-fixture route verifies the routing contract without substituting demo store data.
